notes.title: The GIGILS Playtest is Live – Play Now!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We’re thrilled to finally open the doors to the [b]GIGILS Playtest[/b] — live on Steam all weekend until Monday (Sept 22)![/p][p][/p][p]In GIGILS, you’ll step into chaotic battles as quirky alien creatures who bite, evolve, and brawl their way to victory.[/p][list][*][p]Select one of many classes, each with unique abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Hunt and eat your opponents to grow stronger[/p][/*][*][p]Capture control points in fast-paced battles[/p][/*][*][p]Ride insects and dominate the battlefield[/p][/*][*][p]Customize your character and experiment with different abilities each match[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Every fight is unpredictable, every evolution makes you more dangerous, and every match tells a new story.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b][u]To join[/u][/b], head to the GIGILS Steam page, click “[b]Request Access[/b],” and jump right in.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback is incredibly important — please share your experiences, highlights, and thoughts with us during this playtest. Together, we’ll shape GIGILS into the ultimate alien brawler.[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the battlefield![/p]

notes.title: Gigils – Playtest Begins September 19th
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676479/c499b1b41d0d08320731a35fb5c598a6339a22aa.png"][/img][/p][p][b]GIGILS Playtest Starts September 19th![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that the [i]GIGILS[/i] Playtest kicks off on [b]Friday, September 19th at 10 AM PST | 12 PM CST | 1 PM EST | 7 PM CEST[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]The playtest will run from [b]Friday through Monday[/b], giving you the entire weekend to jump in, test the game, and share your thoughts.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]What’s in the Playtest?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Choose between [b]multiple classes[/b], each with unique abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Experiment with [b]different ability loadouts[/b] to find your playstyle.[/p][/*][*][p]Experience a [b]selection of maps[/b] designed for intense battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Participate in [b]Capture the Point[/b] mode for action-packed team fights.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]✅ [b]How to Join:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sign up for the Playtest right here on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]On Friday, you’ll get access to download and play during the test window.[/p][/*][/list][p]✅ [b]How to Help:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Please share your feedback with us within Steam Discussion or join our [url="https://discord.gg/E5XHwJB9Rs"]Discord[/url].[/p][/*][*][p]Your feedback is crucial for balancing and polishing the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]And if you enjoy the experience, don’t forget to [b]wishlist GIGILS[/b] to stay updated on future news and releases![/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to see your strategies unfold this weekend — and hear your thoughts afterward.[/p]
